# Goal
Kama round 11 only. C1 freshness: 9 legacy knowledge files missing 27 provenance fields -> 0 missing, by appended honest provenance, original bytes retained. C2 coverage: missing served-identity crosswalk -> one source-grounded entry separating availability, loaded models, alias identity, and readiness. No runtime integration or outside verification claimed. MISSION assigns operability+freshness (both 8); C1 works lowest LIVE tie. Protocol/CORPUS/QUALITY bind. Existing round-10 non-author review at corpus/lessons/round-10-verifier-spotcheck.md is immutable.
# Contract
Work only /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin. Leaf only; no delegation, commits, pushes, tests/lint/build/formatters mid-flight. Write only explicitly owned files and your unique reportDir/<seat-name>.md evidence output; never sibling reports. Parent owns LOG.md, SCORECARD.md, SKILL.md, corpus/README.md, QUALITY.md, round-11 lesson and integration. Read other assigned files as needed. No host config/env/credential reads, no service changes, no endpoint census. Source opening public vendor documentation is allowed. Return concise actual evidence, exact quotes <=25 words with URL/date/location, defects and limits. Do not fabricate output. Parent-dispatched seats are author advisors, not outside non-author verifiers.
You and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in the report). Read /home/vgpnk/.agents/AGENTS.md policy authorization and repo PROVINCE.md/QUALITY.md. Report installs; no need to install absent necessity.
